resources.string: QuestVision AI uses the rear camera to read questions on your computer screen. Photos stay on this device.
Camera access was denied. Enable it in Settings to use QuestVision AI.
This device has no rear camera, which QuestVision AI requires.
Camera in use by another app
Couldn\'t capture the photo. Try again.
Automatic monitoring isn\'t supported on this device.
No captures yet. Captures appear here as soon as they are saved, manual or automatic.
Session %1$s · changes %2$d · photos %3$d · new %4$d · repeated %5$d · unreadable %6$d · failed %7$d
Only the %1$d newest captures not kept are stored, plus those waiting for or analyzed by the AI; open one and tap Keep to preserve it.
Same question as before — photo discarded
Couldn\'t read the text — trying again
New key to replace the stored one
Couldn\'t store the key securely on this device.
The key contains invalid characters (spaces or line breaks inside it?).

The key is encrypted on this phone with the Android Keystore, but the app must decrypt it to call OpenAI directly. Whoever controls the unlocked phone (debug builds with USB debugging, root, malware) could still extract it. Use a key created only for QuestVision, never share the phone unlocked, and revoke the key on platform.openai.com if in doubt.

Limit the damage of a leak: on platform.openai.com create a dedicated project, set a hard monthly budget of US$ %1$.2f on it, and create this key inside that project (restricted permissions, prepaid credits, no auto-recharge).
Requests are sent to OpenAI only when you tap Analyze on a photo (manual, one at a time); nothing is sent automatically yet.
Photo saved, but not recorded in the history database — it will be recovered on the next start
This photo is not in the history database yet; it is added the next time the app starts.
The OCR text has no complete question (title, statement and alternatives). Choose Image to send the photo.
OpenAI rejected the key (401). Check or replace it in Settings.
Access denied by OpenAI (403): region or key permissions.
Too many requests (429). Wait a moment and analyze again.
No credits or the spend limit was reached (429). Check billing and limits on the OpenAI platform.
OpenAI rejected the request (model, size or parameters).
The connection to OpenAI failed. If the request had already gone out, it may still have been processed and billed. The photo and its data were kept.
No answer in time. It may still have been processed and billed.
Cancelled. If it had already reached OpenAI, it may still be billed.
The answer came in an unexpected format and was not saved.
The answer was cut short (output limit). Raise the limit in Settings or try again.
Interrupted when the app closed, before an answer arrived. OpenAI may still have processed and billed it.
Unexpected error. The photo and its data were kept; if the request had gone out, it may have been billed.
No OpenAI key is stored. Add it in Settings.
This question is already being analyzed.
The limit of requests per 24 hours was reached (Settings). Failed and cancelled requests count too.
The photo could not be read.
Another question is being analyzed; one at a time.
Check this answer before relying on it.
Requests in the last 24 h: %1$d of %2$d

First real request: this question will be sent to OpenAI (%1$s, %2$s). Estimate: up to about US$ %3$s per request (approximate, not a cap). The app\'s limits are not a spend cap: keep a hard monthly limit on the OpenAI project.
Estimate before sending: up to about US$ %1$s per request. Approximate; the bill is what OpenAI counts.
Image mode: the estimate leaves out the photo\'s own tokens, as OpenAI publishes no image token count for this model. The observed cost of the first image request shows it.
Observed cost: US$ %1$s (reported tokens × published prices; the OpenAI dashboard is authoritative)
Observed cost: not available (no token counts or unknown processing tier)
The last request for this question ended without an answer. OpenAI may have processed and billed it anyway. Sending again is a new request, billed separately.
Question already analyzed — photo discarded, nothing sent
Incomplete question — kept, not sent; waiting for a better capture
Automatic AI sending is off in this version: %1$d question(s) ready for Analyze
AI paused: session limit reached. Capturing goes on; sending resumes only in a new session
AI paused: 24-hour limit reached. Capturing goes on; sending resumes only in a new session
AI paused: no OpenAI key saved. Capturing goes on
AI paused: no answer (connection); nothing is resent. Capturing goes on
AI paused: OpenAI refused the request. Capturing goes on
start of the question not found
The question\'s area could not be found in the photo; nothing was sent
Little free storage: monitoring paused so no capture fails
Another question is being analyzed; try again when it finishes
Send this question to OpenAI (%1$s, %2$s)? It uses credits from your account: up to about US$ %3$s per request (approximate, not a cap).
" Plus the image, which is not estimated. Only the question\'s crop is sent."
This photo is no longer on the phone. The AI\'s answer and the request record were kept: open them with the AI button.
Not discarded: the AI is analyzing this question. Try again when it finishes.
The capture could not be discarded; nothing was lost.
There are no pending captures to clean.

plurals.item: %1$d pending capture, never sent to the AI (%2$s MB, from %3$s to %4$s), will be deleted: photo and record. Answered, in-analysis, failed, already-sent and kept captures are never touched. This can\'t be undone.

%1$d pending captures, never sent to the AI (%2$s MB, from %3$s to %4$s), will be deleted: photos and records. Answered, in-analysis, failed, already-sent and kept captures are never touched. This can\'t be undone.
